parts.text: (g) Dilute nitric acid, HNO 3 (aq), reacts with aqueous calcium hydroxide, Ca(OH) 2 (aq), as shown. 2HNO 3 (aq) + Ca(OH) 2 (aq) → Ca(NO 3 ) 2 (aq) + 2H 2 O(l) 20.0 cm 3 of 0.0150 mol / dm 3 Ca(OH) 2 (aq) reacts with 25.0 cm 3 of HNO 3 (aq).
